links.outcome: Association between hospital AI usage intensity and misdiagnosis rate for acute imaging-dependent tracer condition
links.effect: Higher AI usage intensity was positively associated with misdiagnosis rates (β = 0.28, p < 0.001), suggesting automation bias in time-sensitive acute triage; attenuated by high public trust and remoteness.
links.quote: Within the specific context of the tracer condition, higher AI usage intensity was positively associated with misdiagnosis rates (β = 0.28, p < 0.001), suggesting a pattern of "automation bias" in time-sensitive acute triage.

screen.reason: Empirical observational study using real hospital deployment panel data and public survey data examining the association between AI usage intensity and diagnostic errors (automation bias) in acute imaging.
